seo.title: Documents
seo.seo_title: AI search across your own documents
seo.seo_description: Ask a question in plain language: the answer comes from your own documents, with its sources. By default, indexing is computed on the instance's own server.

translation.headline: The right clause. The right version. Found.
translation.subheadline: Ask your question in plain language. The answer comes from your own documents, cites its sources and sends you back to the original passage.

blocks.role: Problème : un cabinet de services professionnels.

translation.title: Documents you cannot find.
translation.body:
A professional-services firm accumulates contracts, quotes, procedures and file notes, spread across several folders and several versions. Finding the clause in an old contract means digging through four folders and calling a colleague.

The example is constructed to illustrate the principle; it is not a customer's result.

items.title: Several versions.
items.text: Which one is right? The signed one, or the last one edited?

items.title: Memory in people's heads.
items.text: When someone leaves, landmarks leave with them.

items.title: Searches to repeat.
items.text: The same question, asked by three people, is searched three times.

blocks.role: Ce que fait le système : constituer la base, répondre avec sources, résumer, extraire.

translation.title: What the system does.
translation.intro: Three WorkStudio functions, assembled for your case.

cards.title: A knowledge base.
cards.text: You drop in documents (PDF, Word, text, web pages) or connect a synchronized source. They are split and indexed (filed so they can be found quickly); by default, the computation happens on the instance's own server.

cards.title: Answers with their sources.
cards.text: The agent searches the base first, answers, numbers its sources and makes them clickable. A safeguard can check that the answer is faithful to your documents.

cards.title: Summaries and extracts.
cards.text: A starter template summarizes a contract (deadlines, amounts, clauses to have reviewed). It does not replace a lawyer. Scanned documents can be read too, more slowly.

cards.title: Structured fields.
cards.text: When a document follows a known form (quote, purchase order), the system pulls out fields and files them in a table.

blocks.role: Ce que reçoit l'équipe, et le bénéfice.

translation.title: What your team receives.
translation.body: A way to ask your own documents a question, in WorkStudio's internal Assistant or in a chat you publish. The expected benefit: less time searching, less dependence on one person's memory. No time saved is announced; the effect is measured during a pilot, on your real questions.

items.title: An answer and its sources.
items.text: A click opens the document or shows the excerpt used.

items.title: A company memory.
items.text: Knowledge of the files stays in the base when someone leaves.

items.title: Traces to review.
items.text: Questions left unanswered reveal what your documents do not say.

blocks.role: Ce qui reste sous contrôle, avec limites.

cards.title: You choose the bases.
cards.text: The agent only consults the document bases you open to it. Access rights are set per base and per workspace, not document by document.

cards.title: Your documents stay with you.
cards.text: By default, indexing is computed on the instance's own server and no document leaves it. An external service is a written choice.

cards.title: No legal advice.
cards.text: The contract summary flags clauses to have reviewed. It replaces neither a lawyer nor a careful reading.

cards.title: The AI can be wrong.
cards.text: A model can misread a passage. The cited sources let you check, and we test faithfulness to the documents during the pilot.

cards.title: Web search stays a choice.
cards.text: If it is turned on for an agent, its queries leave the instance: we do not turn it on for agents that handle confidential data.

blocks.role: FAQ propre à la solution documents.

items.question: Which file types?
items.answer: PDFs, Word documents, text and web pages. Scanned documents are read with a reading model, more slowly.

items.question: Are my documents sent elsewhere?
items.answer: By default, no: indexing is computed on the instance's own server. If you choose an external model to answer, the excerpts used are sent to it; we say so beforehand, in writing.

items.question: Does the agent say when it finds nothing?
items.answer: That is the goal of the configuration, and we check it during the pilot on your documents. A faithfulness safeguard reduces unsupported answers; it does not eliminate them.

items.question: Can we limit what each person sees?
items.answer: You limit what each agent consults, base by base. Document-by-document access rights are not announced today.

translation.title: Question your documents.
translation.text: We prepare a demonstration on fictional documents, then we talk about yours and where they should stay.
